title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Cheran ties Pallavan's leg to Pandian's, shocking Chozhan. Meanwhile, Nadesan claims to be Sembaruthi's husband to her owner and admits to Nila that he stayed at her place.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Mathi joins Suresh at his police station's Silver Jubilee function. While Suresh is already in awe of her beauty, his senior praises their match.

title: Bigg Boss
episodeTitle: BBTam Day 80: BB has a Little Fan
description: Tension over a tea mix-up and duty shifting gives way to heartwarming moments. Prithvi and Ansar's families arrive, with Ansar's kids charming Bigg Boss.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Tamizhselvi asks Sethupathi to let her raise Azhagar, upsetting Rajangam and Mohana. Elsewhere, Eshwari instructs her lawyer to get Nadesan addicted to drugs and alcohol.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Enraged by Arjun's opposition to Madhu's marriage to Shyam, her father slaps him. Knowing Madhu is his sister's daughter, Karikalan firmly objects to Arjun marrying her.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Kanmani feels blessed as Anbu fulfils her heartfelt wish to have her family at the baby shower. Meanwhile, Vennila provokes Rajeshwari to take revenge on Kanmani.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Rejecting Azhagappan's food arrangements, his VIP guest asks for Murugan's dishes and praises the taste. Furious, Azhagappan gets Kumaran drunk and humiliates him.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Anxious about unemployment, Senthil asks Kathir to join his travel business. However, Raji strongly objects, citing past business setbacks due to his interference.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Muthu and Ravi catch the thief who robbed Manoj's appliance store. As Muthu and Meena brief the police, an emotional Manoj reopens his store and gifts them dresses.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Prabhakaran and Abinaya track Sathish, hand him to the police, and expose Divakar as the mastermind. As both get arrested, Sandhya and Vethanayagam drop Vetri's case.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Pechi learns Senthamizh eloped with Thennavan, who plots to ruin her life. As Rasathi hides the truth from the groom's family, a distressed Pechi seeks Mayandi's support.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Rishi shoots Ayyappan after escaping from Paraman to hide the truth about Ashok's murder. Finding Ayyappan injured on the roadside, Paraman rushes him to the hospital.
